sentence_stem: If you come to my party on Saturday,
correct_completion: we can play games and eat cake.
full_sentence: If you come to my party on Saturday, we can play games and eat cake.

options.text: I am going to the shop yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This mixes a present tense with 'yesterday'. It also does not describe the result of the condition.

options.text: we can play games and eat cake.

options.why_wrong: This is a question about the past. It does not complete the result of the first clause.
This gives unrelated information and does not describe what happens if the guest comes.

explanation: After 'if' in the first part, we need a main clause with a future or modal result. Learners whose first language does not mark the future with a separate form may forget the modal or the subject-verb order in the result clause.
